unit_attributes.statement: A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with the requirements of Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57 and 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69 and 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in this rule are met.

A generator may comply with the conditions for exemption in rule 3745-52-15 instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of rule 3745-52-15.

Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, under satellite accumulation conditions for exemption.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, the generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials, shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers shall be separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.logic_explanation: The baseline duty requires closing at all times. Exceptions apply during waste handling or during necessary temporary venting under either of two sub-reasons.
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a container holding hazardous waste shall be closed at all times during accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste; or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment, or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a generator shall mark or label the generator's container with the words "Hazardous Waste" and an indication of the hazards of the contents (examples include, but are not limited to, the applicable hazardous waste characteristics [i.e., ignitable, corrosive, reactive, toxic]; hazard communication consistent with the department of transportation requirements at 49 CFR Part 172 subpart E [labeling] or subpart F [placarding]; a hazard statement or pictogram consistent with the occupational safety and health administration hazard communication standard at 29 CFR 1910.1200; or a chemical hazard label consistent with the national fire protection association code 704).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.

unit_attributes.logic_explanation: A generator exceeding the specified accumulation limits has three consecutive calendar days to either comply with central accumulation area rules or remove the excess to one of three specified destinations.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following within three consecutive calendar days: comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area to either a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or an off-site designated facility.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When a generator accumulates acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Within three consecutive calendar days, the generator must either (1) comply with central accumulation area requirements, or (2) remove the excess to (i) an eligible central accumulation area, (ii) an on-site permit by rule or permitted facility, or (iii) an off-site designated facility.

unit_attributes.statement: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period when excess acute or non-acute hazardous waste is accumulated, the generator shall continue to comply with paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of rule 3745-52-15.
unit_attributes.scope_text: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period following accumulation in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15.

unit_attributes.statement: When acute or non-acute hazardous waste is accumulated in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15, the generator shall mark or label the containers holding the excess accumulation of hazardous waste with the date the excess amount began accumulating.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When hazardous waste is accumulated in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15.

unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator shall meet the preparedness and prevention requirements of paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code and emergency procedures of paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator.

unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator shall meet the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator.

unit_attributes.statement: For dates of non-regulatory government publications, publications of recognized organizations and associations, federal rules, and federal statutory provisions referenced in rule 3745-52-15, see rule 3745-50-11 of the Administrative Code titled "Incorporated by reference."
